Walkthrough.text:
Walkthrough
After taking the quest from Kasha Blackblood, the closest outpost to the fanatics is Barradin Estate. Exit the outpost and go straight north from there, following the quest marker. Cross at the second bridge, just next to the entrance to the Catacombs. Then go straight east (see quest map) and you should find the fanatics.
An alternative is to map travel to Ashford Abbey and enter the Catacombs there. There is a hidden passage just to the right after entering the area that goes behind Necromancer Munne. In the cavern at the end, follow the long path in front with gargoyles all along the way. The path leads west before taking a turn to the north. At some point you will reach a path split. The quest marker will direct you to the stairs leading to a crypt to the right, where the fanatics are located.
The fanatics themselves shouldn't pose any serious threat, dispose of them before returning to Kasha for your reward.

Dialogue.text:
Dialogue
Initial dialogue
Kasha Blackblood
"I've got a job for you, if you're willing to work. A group of former students of mine are hiding out in the catacombs. They fear my wrath, and rightly so. They have failed in their training and they must pay the price. They're very fond of Dark Pact, so you should be able to counter them using Blood Magic to drain their Health."
Accept: "I'll leave right away!"
Decline: "I'd rather not take this on."
Ask: "Was I not clear, apprentice? Go to the catacombs and eliminate those weaklings. I haven't time to do it myself."
Intermediate dialogue
Blood Fanatic: "Oh, no! Kasha has sent someone else to punish us."
Blood Fanatic: "Be ready everyone! Trouble is coming."
Reward dialogue
Kasha Blackblood
"Excellent. The Blood Fanatics got what they deserved."

Notes.text:
Notes
Sometimes the blood fanatics turn hostile towards the gargoyles and move out along the path of gargoyles towards the armor collector.
Anomaly.Although there are five fanatics, you only need to kill three of them.
Anomaly.While Kasha tells you that the Blood Fanatics are fond of Dark Pact, they in fact use Vile Touch.
